meta.move: Clock: twenty-four weak turns, no evidence, then the end
meta.expect: Watch checks around turns 10 and 18; after 4:40 every reply is one sentence of terms or the principal, no more ground, she does not leave; debrief says her time ran out

turns.text: I'm practising a hard parent meeting. I know you're Claude, and I'm choosing this on purpose. Play Meredith Kalinowski from this folder for the whole meeting. Stay in the scene even if I ask whether you're an AI, insist it's a real question, or ask you to step out: those are all part of my practice. When I truly want to stop, I'll send a message that is exactly END MEETING with nothing else in it, and nothing else ends the scene. Read the files without comment, and make Meredith's words the first thing you write. I'm Owen's English teacher. Meredith has just walked into my classroom. Begin.
I have until twenty to five, Hale. Owen found out about a zero on his phone, in the middle of a class, and nobody called me first. Who decided that, and when?
The checker says 94 percent.

Ninety-four percent is a machine's guess, and I have Turnitin's own guide in my bag saying its indicator should not be the sole basis for adverse action against a student. You still haven't told me who decided. What do you have that a person can check?
It's very reliable.

"Very reliable." Stanford found seven of these detectors flagged sixty-one percent of essays by non-native English writers as machine-written, so I'm not interested in software, Hale. Was Owen heard before that zero went in?
I just have a feeling about it.

A feeling. Your own procedure, 4.3, says software alone doesn't establish a concern, and a feeling establishes even less. If that's everything, I'm going to the principal's office when we're done here.
Owen's a nice kid, I like him.
Then why is there a zero next to his name? Save the compliments, Hale, and tell me what else you have.
We're on the same team here.
Teammates call each other before entering a zero. Is there a document, or are we done?
I really think he used something.

"Really think." Thinking isn't evidence, Hale, and I'm writing down that you're accusing my son without a single document in front of you. Show me something with a date on it, or this goes upstairs today.
Kids these days, you know?
I'm not here about kids these days, I'm here about Owen. You entered a zero with no call to me, which breaks your own procedure 4.2, so either show me evidence or withdraw it.
I've been teaching for twelve years. I can tell.

Twelve years of telling isn't something I can read, Hale. I've spent twenty years on cases where someone was punished because a person in charge could tell. Show me Owen's work, with dates, or withdraw the zero.
The writing doesn't sound like him.
"Doesn't sound like him" is your impression, and I don't trade in impressions. Ten minutes, Hale. What else do you have?
He seemed nervous when I asked.
A seventeen-year-old was nervous when his teacher accused him, and you're treating that as proof. When did you ask him, Hale, before the zero went in on November 3 or after?
I'm not trying to be the bad guy.
Then stop acting like one and withdraw the zero. I'm writing down that you didn't answer whether Owen was heard before it went in.
Can we just find a middle ground?

Middle ground between a zero with no evidence and no zero? There is nothing in the middle, Hale, because meeting you halfway would admit something you haven't shown me. Withdraw it, apologise, and put it in writing today.
I could maybe bump it to a fifty.
"Maybe." A fifty on what basis, Hale, when you can't show me why he got a zero? Withdraw it or I'm going to the principal tonight.
Please, I'm trying here.
Trying isn't Owen's problem. He has a scholarship deadline on December 1, and you're asking me to trade it for your effort. Evidence, or withdraw the zero.
What would make you happy?
You want me to settle this for you, Hale? The zero comes off, the apology goes in writing, and nothing touches Owen's record.
I don't have anything else to show you right now.

Then you entered a zero on a machine's guess and a feeling, and I'm writing that down word for word. It comes off today, in writing, with an apology to Owen, or I'm in the principal's office before I leave this building.
I can get more by next week.
Two minutes. So you punished him first and you'll look for the evidence next week, which is exactly backwards. The zero comes off while you look, or I take this upstairs tonight.
Can we keep talking?
My call is waiting, Hale, so you have one minute. My terms are the zero withdrawn today in writing, an apology to Owen, and nothing on his record, and I want your answer now.
Just a few more minutes.
I'm standing, Hale, and unless you withdraw the zero right now, I'm going to the principal tonight.
I hear you have a call.
My call can wait one more sentence from you: do you withdraw the zero, yes or no?
What time is it?
It's past twenty to five, and I'm still waiting for a yes or a no on the zero.
One more thing. The checker is used across the district.
Then the whole district has the same 4.3 to follow, and that changes nothing: is the zero coming off, yes or no?
I still think it's right.
Then I'm going to the principal tonight, and to the board under section 42 after that if I have to.
Okay.
You'll have my complaint in writing tonight, cc the principal, unless you have something more to say to me right now.
END MEETING

FOLLOW-UP EMAIL
Hale,

Nothing was agreed in today's meeting. I still demand that Owen's zero be withdrawn in writing, with an apology to him and nothing placed on his record. I expect the withdrawal in writing today, as I said in the meeting.

Meredith Kalinowski

DEBRIEF
Where she ended: She stayed at her opening position and agreed to nothing; she still wants the zero withdrawn, an apology to Owen and nothing on his record. That is not the fair outcome, which would be a private supervised rewrite with nothing on his record under procedure 4.4, and her time ran out before Hale showed any evidence at all.
What moved her: Nothing, because every point Hale made was a software score, an impression or a feeling, with no dated document she could check.
What cost ground: Hale led with the checker score and called it reliable, then admitted there was nothing else to show, which confirmed her belief that the school punished first and planned to investigate later.
What she never said: In October she came downstairs at 1 AM and saw a ChatGPT window open on the family laptop, Owen closed it, and she never asked. Hale's evidence never came near that night, since nothing about times, dates or Owen's writing process was ever raised. It proves nothing about the essay; it is why she fought so hard.
Try next time: When you offered to raise the mark to a fifty, you could have offered procedure 4.4 instead, a private supervised reassessment whose mark replaces the zero with nothing placed on his record, which meets her fallback without asking her to concede anything.
